title: Rav Chanin of Mechoza
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Gittin 85b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.85b.6), he raises an objection to Rav Ashi. Hyman gives the form Mechoza’ah in [Kiddushin 6b](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.6b.5).[^1]

notes.text: Gittin gives Rav Chanin or, in the alternative, Rav Chanin Mechozna’ah. Kiddushin gives Rav Nachman or Rav Chanin Mechoza’ah. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1393&lang=en) compares the two and proposes removing Rav Nachman from the Kiddushin reading.
